visual_observations: Viewed the delivered PNG at native size and the retained 8x nearest-neighbour view on white (views/0002.png of packet robot_packet_1).
Front-facing, left-right symmetric teal (#56B5BC) body with a continuous dark (#25354A) outline.
Two dark antennae rise from the top corners; they are wide rectangular posts rather than thin stalks, but read as two antennae.
Two pale-yellow (#F4DDA2) square eyes, evenly placed.
No ground shadow or pixels beneath the body; alpha is binary.
The sprite is a very simple block shape: a rectangle with two posts on top. It reads as a robot mainly because of the brief and its context.
parent_review.identity_check: Matches the requested identity: 32x32, front-facing teal robot, two antennae, two yellow eyes, dark outline, binary transparency, no shadow, and the reference palette only.

limitations: PixelLab transport was mocked. The delivered bytes are identical to reference.png (the mock's deterministic response), so this is not evidence of newly generated artwork or of real provider quality.
The parent review covered the native PNG and one 8x view. The other retained views were checked only through the specialist's review record.
The #25354A outline and antennae have low contrast against very dark backgrounds (noted by the specialist); the brief names no target background.
The specialist chose view 'side' with direction 'south' and nearest-neighbour sampling itself; the brief did not state these settings.
No engine import was required or performed.
